from manim import *
import numpy as np

# Use the provided TeachingScene base class without modification.
class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

        )

        self.lecture[1].set_color(YELLOW_CLR)

        red_group = VGroup(red_1, red_2)
        
        # Visual groupings

        self.place_at_grid(red_count, 'B5', scale_factor=0.8)

        # ValueTracker for smooth rotation

            center = pivot_center.get_value()
            dir_vec = np.array([np.cos(current_angle), np.sin(current_angle), 0])

        self.play(angle_tracker.animate.set_value(PI/4), run_time=2.5)

        self.lecture[2].set_color(WHITE_CLR)
        self.lecture[3].set_color(YELLOW_CLR)
        
        # Visualizing the trade with arrows
        arrow_to_pivot = Arrow(self.grid['B4'], self.grid['B4'] + UP*0.5, color=HIGHLIGHT_CLR, buff=0.1)
        arrow_from_pivot = Arrow(self.grid['C3'], self.grid['C3'] + DOWN*0.5, color=RED_CLR, buff=0.1)
        
        self.play(GrowArrow(arrow_to_pivot), GrowArrow(arrow_from_pivot))
        self.wait(0.5)
        
        # Swap colors and roles
        self.play(
            pivot_p.animate.set_color(RED_CLR),
            red_1.animate.set_color(WHITE_CLR),
            pivot_center.animate.set_value(red_1.get_center()),
            FadeOut(arrow_to_pivot), FadeOut(arrow_from_pivot)
        )
        
        # Continue rotation to show it's now pivoting around red_1
        self.play(angle_tracker.animate.increment_value(PI/6), run_time=1.5)
        self.wait(1.5)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 5 ===
        # "The total count on each side remains perfectly balanced."
        self.lecture[3].set_color(WHITE_CLR)
        self.lecture[4].set_color(YELLOW_CLR)

        new_blue_group = VGroup(blue_1, blue_2)
        new_red_group = VGroup(pivot_p, red_2)
        
        rect_blue_final = SurroundingRectangle(new_blue_group, color=BLUE_CLR, buff=0.2)
        rect_red_final = SurroundingRectangle(new_red_group, color=RED_CLR, buff=0.2)
        
        self.play(Create(rect_blue_final), Create(rect_red_final))
        # Pulse counts to emphasize the invariant (L004)
        self.play(Indicate(blue_count, color=YELLOW_CLR), Indicate(red_count, color=YELLOW_CLR))
        self.wait(2.0)
        
        # Cleanup updaters
        windmill_line.remove_updater(line_updater)
